tools.name: calculate_tax
tools.description:
Run an Irish tax calculator and return the full result.

Available calculators:
  - base: Calculate income tax, USC, and PRSI for a given salary. Supports single/married, multiple employments, tax credits.
  - refund: Estimate a PAYE tax refund by comparing tax paid vs tax owed.
  - tax-free-earning

tools.name: get_calculator_schema
tools.description:
Get the JSON Schema for a specific tax calculator.

Returns input fields, types, defaults, and constraints.
Use before calling `calculate_tax` if you need to know
what fields are required.

tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description:
List all available Irish tax calculators with their names and descriptions.

Returns a list of calculators that can be used with the `calculate_tax` tool.

tools.name: get_tax_constants
tools.description:
Get Irish tax constants.

Returns tax bands, rates, USC rates, PRSI rates,
tax credits, and thresholds. Useful for understanding
the current tax rules without running a full calculation.

tools.name: get_key_dates
tools.description: Get important Irish Revenue dates and deadlines (filing dates, payment dates, etc.).

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "calculate_tax" is 3615 chars, far longer than this server's median (353). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Run an Irish tax calculator and return the full result. Available calculators: - base: Calculate income tax, USC, and PRSI for a given salary. Supports single/m…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_calculator_schema" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get the JSON Schema for a specific tax calculator. Returns input fields, types, defaults, and constraints. Use before calling `calculate_tax` if you need to kno…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_revenue_document_text, get_tax_treaty_text · Private data: calculate_tax, search_revenue_documents, get_revenue_document_text, list_revenue_document_categories, search_tax_treaties, get_tax_treaty_text · Public sink: calculate_tax · Destructive: calculate_tax.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_revenue_document_text, get_tax_treaty_text · Private data: calculate_tax, search_revenue_documents, get_revenue_document_text, list_revenue_document_categories, search_tax_treaties, get_tax_treaty_text · Public sink: calculate_tax · Destructive: calculate_tax

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
